neighbours.label: ' and' joining two coordinated technical noun phrases in a list (scientific / technical prose)
fire: The enzyme breaks down the sugars, the starches and proteins found in the sample.
Each cell contains ribosomes, mitochondria and lysosomes suspended in the cytoplasm.
The script writes a config file, a cache folder and a backup of the database.
Heating the alloy changes its density, its hardness and conductivity at once.
The kit includes resistors, capacitors and diodes for the first experiment.
Samples were tested for lead, mercury and cadmium before the trial began.
The soil holds nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium in varying amounts.
The installer copies the libraries, the headers and documentation to disk.
quiet: The enzyme breaks down the sugars found in the sample within an hour.
Each cell contains many ribosomes suspended in the thick cytoplasm.
The script writes a single config file to the home folder on startup.
Heating the alloy slowly changes its hardness over several minutes.
The kit includes a resistor for the first experiment in the manual.
Samples were tested for lead before the trial began last spring.
The soil holds a great deal of nitrogen after the autumn rains.
The installer copies the libraries to disk when it first runs.
